steps.description: Configure Tailwind for dark mode (if not already)
steps.details: Update tailwind.config.js to enable dark mode using class strategy. Example: darkMode: ['class', '.dark']

steps.description: Update global CSS to support dark mode
steps.details: In src/index.css, add Tailwind base styles and define any custom properties for light/dark mode if needed. Ensure Tailwind's dark mode classes are utilized.

steps.description: Redesign Header component to be clean and minimal (Apple style)
steps.details: Use flexbox, appropriate spacing, and Tailwind classes for a clean look. Remove unnecessary borders, shadows, and use subtle colors. Implement a mode toggle button (light/dark) using morphicons.

steps.description: Redesign Sidebar component to be clean and minimal (Apple style)
steps.details: Use a clean layout with ample padding, subtle hover effects, and minimal icons. Replace text labels with icons where appropriate, using morphicons. Ensure it adapts to dark mode.

steps.description: Replace icons in Header and Sidebar with morphicons
steps.details: Import morphicons (e.g., import { Moon, Sun } from 'morphicons') and replace existing icon components with morphicon equivalents. Use the appropriate morphicon for each action (e.g., Moon for dark mode, Sun for light mode).

steps.description: Update other components as needed (Dashboard, EditorWorkspace, etc.)
steps.details: Apply the same clean, minimal design principles. Ensure consistent spacing, typography, and color usage. Replace any remaining icons with morphicons.

steps.description: Test light and dark mode switching
steps.details: Add a toggle switch in the Header (or another accessible location) that toggles a 'dark' class on the root element (e.g., document.documentElement). Verify that all components adapt correctly to both light and dark modes.
